<div id="member-idx">
<h1>
<a href="search/search-acr-directory.aspx">Meet Your Fellow Members</a></h1>
<div class="member">
<div id="bio">
<img alt="Christopher Hackley" id="MainContent_acrMemberBio_imgMemberImage" src="assets/images/member_photos/6258.jpg" style="width:82px;" title="Christopher Hackley, Royal Holloway University of London"/>
<div id="bio-link">
<a href="web/member/profile.aspx?MemberId=6258" id="MainContent_acrMemberBio_hlProfileLink">
                View Profile</a>
</div>
</div>
<p>
</p><div id="bio-name">
<span id="MainContent_acrMemberBio_lblMemberName">Christopher Hackley</span>
</div>
<br/>
<span id="MainContent_acrMemberBio_lblMemberBio"><p><font face="Times New Roman, Times, serif">I'm Professor of Marketing at Royal Holloway, which is the fifth largest college of the University of London, UK. My PhD at Strathclyde University, Scotland, UK, was a discourse analytic study of the advertising development process in top advertising agencies. Royal Holloway School of Management Marketing group has all round strengths including CCT and critical and comparative research. </font><font face="Times New Roman, Times, serif">My main teaching is in advertising and critical marketing, while my PhD supervisions have included Asian fashion branding and marketing, political marketing, childrens' experience of online computer and video games, and young peoples' experiences of television product placement. I'm interested in the ways marketing and consumption frame our lives and my recent research includes projects on Asian consumer identity; on young people, alcohol and identity; and on the role of critical social science in research in marketing. I'm a fan of Delta Blues music and I like to relax by playing some Robert Johnson and Son House.                               </font></p></span>
<p></p>
</div>
</div>

<h1>
            News &amp; Announcements <a href="web/member-news/news.aspx">/ View All</a></h1>
<h3>
                    Passing of Dr. Gary Bamossy</h3>
<p>
                    It is with great sadness that we report the passing of our dear friend and colleague, Dr. Gary Bamossy.<br/>
<span class="grey">
                        September 17, 2019
                        / </span><a href="http://www.acrwebsite.org/web/acr-content/1100/passing-of-dr-gary-bamossy.aspx">more »</a>
</p>
<h3>
                    Welcome - ACR Communications and Membership Managers</h3>
<p>
                    Anne Hamby (Boise State University) and Adam Craig (University of Kentucky) have agreed to take on the role of communications manager and membership manager respectively.
                    <span class="grey">
                        July 30, 2019
                        / </span><a href="http://www.acrwebsite.org/web/acr-content/1099/welcome---acr-communications-and-membership-managers.aspx">more »</a>
</p>
<h3>
                    Call for ACR Officer Nominations</h3>
<p>
                    The ACR Officer Nominating Committee is seeking nominations for three ACR Board positions. Deadline: <strong>August 19, 2019</strong><br/>
<span class="grey">
                        July 29, 2019
                        / </span><a href="http://www.acrwebsite.org/web/acr-content/1098/call-for-acr-officer-nominations.aspx">more »</a>
</p>
<h3>
                    2020 ACR FELLOW NOMINATIONS</h3>
<p>
                    ACR members are invited to send nominations for the 2020 Fellow in Consumer Behavior Award to the Fellows Nominating Committee. <strong>Deadline: August 19, 2019 </strong>Richard Lutz: <a href="mailto:richard.lutz@warrington.ufl.edu">richard.lutz@warrington.ufl.edu</a><br/>
<span class="grey">
                        July 1, 2019
                        / </span><a href="http://www.acrwebsite.org/web/acr-content/1096/2020-acr-fellow-nominations.aspx">more »</a>
</p>
<h3>
                    ACR 2019 Conference - Atlanta, GA registration is now open</h3>
<p>
                    ACR 2019 Conference registration is now open: <a href="https://www.acrwebsite.org/account/acr-conference-registration.aspx">https://www.acrwebsite.org/account/acr-conference-registration.aspx</a><br/>
<span class="grey">
                        June 30, 2019
                        / </span><a href="http://www.acrwebsite.org/web/acr-content/1095/acr-2019-conference---atlanta-ga-registration-is-now-open.aspx">more »</a>
</p>
<h3>
                    2019 ACR/Sheth Foundation Dissertation Grants for Topics in Cross-Cultural and Public Purpose Consumer Research</h3>
<p>
                    The purpose of these grants is to support the data collection efforts of new dissertations or those in the preliminary stages of development; awards are designed for dissertation projects initiated in academic year 2018-2019 and designed for completion in 2019-2020. This year the Sheth Foundation has kindly supported this initiative with a matching grant of $10,000, which will be used to fund between two and four doctoral research grants. <strong>Ph.D. candidates at the post-comprehensive exam, dissertation stage should submit proposals after June 17, 2019 but no later than July 17, 2019.</strong>
<span class="grey">
                        June 10, 2019
                        / </span><a href="http://www.acrwebsite.org/web/acr-content/1093/2019-acrsheth-foundation-dissertation-grants-for-topics-in-cross-cultural-and-public-purpose-consumer-research.aspx">more »</a>
</p>
